_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company, whose mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make health care work better.' 'If we fail to effectively estimate, price for and manage our medical costs, the profitability of our risk-based products and services could decline and could materially and adversely affect our results of operations, financial position and cash flows.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based benefits products comprise approximately 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names health benefits, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -15.7%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (FY12 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.5%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +38.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2012-11-09) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.29x (44.6% downside to Bear $29.31 / +152.4% upside to Bull $133.53) | Adj composite 2.75 vs market 1.58: gap +1.17 [UNDERVALUED] | -22% above the EPP floor $67.92 (13x FY12E $5.22) | Conservative 2-yr case: +63.9% total (+31.9%/yr) | At 10.1x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $69.96 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +8.0% YoY in Q3 2012, forward revenues +8% (FY12 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
